name: Fortune's Favor
description: A save-file luck stat, tunable up or down, wired into the Game Corner slot machine, the shiny rate, wild encounters, the fishing rods and a new LOTTO TICKET sold at every Poke Mart. Higher luck leans wild picks toward species you are missing -- always within each map's or rod's own list, never adding outsiders. At MISSINGNO it counts your whole collection, extended storage included, and steps its forced shiny aside once a species is finished so you can fill the normals. The default tier NORMAL is vanilla exactly; REALISTIC is deliberately worse. Tickets pay money or RARE CANDY.
author: Kevin Boggs
